This workflow is automated either side of one manual step, not end to end. Ekly.ai exposes no API to us, so video generation is performed by hand through its web interface. Everything before generation (validation, segmentation, signature, brief planning) and everything after it (import, per-frame scoring, diversity selection, conversion, export) is automated. The run pauses at AWAITING_CLIPS and resumes on import-clips.

3. Candidates — Gate 1 (fidelity) and Gate 2 (diversity)

A clip must pass both gates to be exported. Gate 1 rejects it for drifting off the product; Gate 2 rejects it for looking too much like another clip. Fidelity threshold in use: 51.0.

The most distinct clip in the set is MANSION-marble, which Gate 1 rejected. Being the most different is not the same as being usable — that is precisely why diversity alone cannot decide what ships, and why the two gates are independent.

5. Safe Cut

Product drift in these clips is local and transient, so a clip that dips below threshold for part of its length can still contain a usable ad. Safe Cut trims to the longest contiguous window in which every scored frame clears the threshold, and only when at least 3.0s survives. It only trims — it never regenerates or repairs. Every trimmed clip is re-scored from the trimmed file, not inherited.

Not cut:

  • BASELINE-courtyard — every scored frame already clears the threshold; nothing to cut
  • MANDAP-dusk — every scored frame already clears the threshold; nothing to cut
  • MANSION-marble — longest passing window is 0.00s, under the 3.0s minimum for a usable ad
  • ROOFTOP-night — every scored frame already clears the threshold; nothing to cut

6. Fidelity threshold calibration

Threshold: 51.0 — constructed limit clip -- colour pushed to dE2000 8.28 (a 10-degree hue shift, a visible dye change) and weave to distance 0.303 (blur k=5, weave collapse), with identity and structure held at the median of the real clips. A clip at or below this score has drifted as far as a customer-visible misrepresentation. NOTE: the weakest real clip (44.9) does NOT clear this floor.
